items.briefing:
A recent study by 1Password has found that AI-generated security patches fail to fully fix software vulnerabilities around half the time. This is a timely reminder for any Australian organisation using AI tools to assist with IT security work — automated fixes shouldn't be trusted without human review. Relying solely on AI to patch systems could leave your organisation exposed without you realising it.

**Practical tip:** If your IT team uses AI tools to suggest or apply security fixes, make sure a qualified person always reviews and tests the patch before it's applied to production systems.

featured.title: AI patches fail to fix flaws, 1Password study finds
featured.quote: AI-generated security patches fail over half the time, creating new risks for Australian organisations.
